name: 🔨 Compilar SQLRPGLE → Programa
command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) CLOSQLCSR(*ENDMOD) CVTCCSID(*JOB) COMPILEOPT('TGTCCSID(*JOB)') RPGPPOPT(*LVL2)

name: 🔨 Compilar SQLRPGLE → Módulo
command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OBJTYPE(*MODULE) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) CLOSQLCSR(*ENDMOD) CVTCCSID(*JOB) COMPILEOPT('TGTCCSID(*JOB)') RPGPPOPT(*LVL2)

name: 🔨 Compilar RPGLE → Programa
command: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

name: 🔨 Compilar RPGLE → Módulo
command: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(*SOURCE) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

name: 📤 Exportar miembro QSYS → IFS/Git + commit + push
command: QSYS/CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIBRARY.LIB/&FILE.FILE/&NAME.MBR') TOSTMF('/home/MEYKER/git/Petromovil/&FILE/&NAME.&EXT') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) CVTDTA(*AUTO) STMFCCSID(1208) && cd /home/MEYKER/git/Petromovil && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add '&FILE/&NAME.&EXT' && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'Exporta &LIBRARY/&FILE/&NAME' && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git push origin main

name: 📦 Git: commit + push este archivo
command: cd /home/MEYKER/git/Petromovil && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add '&RELATIVEPATH' && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'Actualiza &NAME (&CURLIB)' && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git push origin main
